test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘6’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c085b2a7b3b49f9564519f2654841c0488adb98f186a9522913ea0d97a4613cd.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) We are taking figures (1) & (2) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4bcb35ec31d345243a3325c6aeb39ef42dd0d8fbe9f69d8816f7de735b841b2.png] 

Here, in the figure numbers, 2 and 3 are common in both the dice, and 4 faces opposite to 5.

2) We are taking figures (2) & (3) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c3fcfd2a5b63177d448652e48cf64b26dae1b00bde34ee085d381bedb28804b.png] 

Here, in the figure numbers, 5 and 2 are common in both the dice and 3 faces opposite to 6.

**Opposite pairs are:-**

⇒ 4 ⇔ 5

⇒ 3 ⇔ 6

⇒ 2 ⇔ 1

So, 3 is the number on the face opposite to 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
